channel.title: PS5 Store AIO - Homebrew Page
channel.description: Mises à jour automatiques pour la catégorie Homebrew Page

item.title: OliSe Player
item.description: Tracker music radio in FastTracker II style, streaming MOD, XM, S3M and IT from The Mod Archive.

item.title: SymphonyStation5
item.description: A native Navidrome music client for the PlayStation 5.

item.title: XashPS5
item.description: Native PS5 port of Xash3D FWGS: Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift up to 4K at 60 FPS with DualSense input. Needs your own Half-Life game data.

item.title: Middle Ages Ping Pong
item.description: Classic ping pong in a medieval setting: play against the computer or a friend on the same console.

item.title: VITA5
item.description: Play a PS Vita on the PS5 over one USB cable.

item.title: Syobon Action
item.description: Native PS5 port of Syobon Action (Cat Mario), the deliberately unfair platformer by Chiku, with DualSense controls, a pause menu and a stage select.

item.title: Afterglow
item.description: Internet radio with 220+ stations and 56 full-screen music visualizer scenes.

item.title: ccleste
item.description: This is a C source port of the original celeste (Celeste classic) for the PICO-8, designed to be portable. Now you can enjoy the port on your PS5.

item.title: Ruffle Flash
item.description: PS5 Port of Ruffle Flash Emulator.

item.title: ScreenTester5
item.description: Screen tester: solid colours and test patterns to find dead or stuck pixels, check uniformity and geometry, and run stuck-pixel recovery.

item.title: SuperTuxKart
item.description: Alpha port of the open-source kart racer SuperTuxKart 1.5, with story mode and local races; network play is switched off.

item.title: Rush 2 Recompiled
item.description: Native PS5 port of Rush 2 Recompiled, the N64 racer recompiled with 4K output and 60 fps; needs your own Rush 2: Extreme Racing USA (USA) ROM.

item.title: Wave Race 64 Recompiled
item.description: Native PS5 port of Wave Race 64: Recompiled, the N64 jet ski racer recompiled with 4K output, 60 fps and a modern water renderer; needs your own Wave Race 64 (USA) (Rev A) ROM.

item.title: Signal Companion
item.description: Set your PS5's light colour and ps5-signal's startup tune, and manage the suite: start, update and autoload ps5-signal, ps5-exporter and ps5-homeassistant, and link the PS5 to Home Assistant.

item.title: Stremio Plus
item.description: Unofficial native Stremio client for PS5 with Prospero UI, add-on sync, torrent streaming, offline downloads and customizable subtitles.

item.title: The Simpsons Game
item.description: Create a PS5-ready The Simpsons Game folder from your Xbox 360 game files, with graphics settings and optional frame generation.

item.title: Jewel Case
item.description: Home-screen ROM launcher that shows every system's games as cartridges and discs with box art and starts each in the right emulator.

item.title: RommPS
item.description: Syncs your emulator saves and states with a RomM server and downloads games from your RomM library.

item.title: Stremio
item.description: Unofficial Stremio client for the PS5

item.title: VLC
item.description: VLC media player for PS5: videos, music, photos, subtitles, DVD images and more

item.title: Prospero Themes
item.description: Theme manager for the PS5 home screen: download community themes, preview and apply .p5theme packs, import them from USB and restore the originals.

item.title: Capy Mobile
item.description: Java phone games (J2ME) on the PS5: a native homebrew emulator app

item.title: Raptor: Call of the Shadows (PS5)
item.description: Unofficial native PS5 port of Raptor: Call of the Shadows with DualSense controls and optional first-launch shareware download.

item.title: XPSemu
item.description: Original Xbox emulator for PS5, based on xemu.

item.title: PSXS5
item.description: PSXS5 (PlayStation X Super 5): a PlayStation 1 emulator running natively on jailbroken PS5, based on PCSX-ReARMed. Cover-flow shelf, xBR upscaling, RetroAchievements, cheats.

item.title: PokeMMO Prospero
item.description: Runs the official, unmodified PokeMMO Linux client natively on a jailbroken PS5.

item.title: CD Player
item.description: Rediscover your audio CDs and fall in love with your music again: a native PS5 player with USB drive support, album art and reactive visuals.

item.title: SwanStationPS5
item.description: SwanStationPS5 is a PlayStation 1 emulator that runs all games using SwanStation core.

item.title: ReKHCoM
item.description: Native PS5 port of Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories (The GBA Version). The European, US and Japanese cartridges are supported; the version is detected from the ROM you provide (no ROM is included).

item.title: DriftCheck
item.description: Controller tester: live sticks with circularity, a rest test that measures stick drift and suggests a deadzone, triggers, buttons, touchpad and motion sensors.

item.title: ProsperoStore
item.description: Native app store for PS5 homebrew: browse this catalog, install apps and keep them up to date.

item.title: ProsperoLight
item.description: Unofficial Moonlight game streaming port for PS5.

item.title: ProsperoTV
item.description: Native IPTV client for PS5.

item.title: ProsperoAI
item.description: Local LLM chat app for PS5.

item.title: ProsperoEden
item.description: Unofficial Eden emulator port for PS5.

item.title: vkQuake
item.description: Native PS5 port of vkQuake, the Vulkan Quake engine, at up to 120 FPS and 4K with DualSense input. Needs your own Quake game data.

item.title: Media Player Classic PS5
item.description: Media Player Classic Home Cinema's window and controls as a native PS5 app, playing local, USB, SMB and network media with FFmpeg.

item.title: Forever Launcher
item.description: Battle.net launcher for World of Warcraft (Retail, Classic and Forever) with a built-in add-on manager; press Options for the Forever menu and L3+R3 for the on-screen keyboard.

item.title: EVO Player
item.description: Media player for PS5 that plays video from USB or internal storage, with hardware decoding up to 4K, 10-bit HDR and surround audio.

item.title: Surround Sound Studio
item.description: Sends Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus, DTS, AAC and TrueHD to your receiver untouched over HDMI, plus a speaker test lab with a 3D sound field.

item.title: Spot5
item.description: Unofficial native Spotify player, not affiliated with Spotify: Home, Your Library, playlists, artists, Now Playing and more, with Spotify Connect. Needs Premium.

item.title: OpenNOW PS5 - Prototype
item.description: Experimental native PS5 GeForce NOW client: a working, console-tested prototype with hardware decoding and GPU presentation.

item.title: Prospero Explorer
item.description: File explorer for PS5 that manages files and archives, plays media, edits text, installs packages and serves files over the network.

item.title: Prospero Multi Tools
item.description: Backup manager for PS5: browse and edit PS1 to PS5, PSP and PS Vita backups, install packages and launch PS1/PS2/PSP titles. Needs the unjail payload.

item.title: Mortalfin
item.description: A native Jellyfin client for the PS5 with a cover-wheel interface, HDR and surround sound passthrough. Beta.

item.title: Seedee5
item.description: A Philips CD-i emulator (SAME_CDI) with a cover-wheel library, NAS support, 4K picture filters and game info; bring your own BIOS and games.

item.title: RetroArch
item.description: Native RetroArch port for PS5 with cores for NES, SNES, GBA, Genesis, arcade, PSP, GameCube/Wii and PS2.

item.title: PS5SX2
item.description: PCSX2 port for PS5 that runs PS2 games natively with a Vulkan renderer, up to 6x resolution and settings from your phone. Bring your own BIOS and games.

item.title: PSFlyCast
item.description: Flycast (Dreamcast, NAOMI and Atomiswave) as a standalone PS5 title on RADV, with a controller-only interface.

item.title: PSSwanStation
item.description: A PlayStation (PS1) emulator built on SwanStation, with a controller-first library, ES-DE themes and game videos, network shares, USB disc drives, CRT shaders and RetroAchievements.

item.title: Nuvio Max'd
item.description: An unofficial native Nuvio client for PS5 with synced watch progress, addon streams, episode skipping and experimental HDR10 playback.

item.title: Spider-Man: Edge of Time
item.description: Unofficial native PS5 port of Spider-Man: Edge of Time. Requires game files from your own copy.

item.title: Quake3e
item.description: Native PS5 port of Quake3e, the improved Quake III Arena engine, drawing with Vulkan at up to 4K with DualSense or USB mouse and keyboard input. Needs your own Quake III Arena game data.

item.title: Dusklight
item.description: Dusklight for PlayStation 5: a homebrew port on RADV (Aurora, Dawn WebGPU, SDL3). Bring your own disc image.

item.title: Wind Waker
item.description: The Wind Waker (GameCube) for PlayStation 5: a homebrew port of SwitchWaker on RADV (Aurora, Dawn WebGPU, SDL3), 4K at 60 fps. Bring your own disc image.

item.title: Mario 64
item.description: Super Mario 64 for PlayStation 5: a homebrew port of Ghostship (libultraship) on RADV, 4K at 60 fps, with the ROM converted on the console. Bring your own ROM.

item.title: Super Mario Sunshine
item.description: Super Mario Sunshine (GameCube) for PlayStation 5: a homebrew port of chasem-dev's sms-pc-port on the PS5 OpenGL SDK, 4K at 60 fps. Bring your own disc image.

item.title: Doom 3 BFG
item.description: Doom 3 BFG Edition for PlayStation 5: a homebrew port of RBDoom3BFG on Vulkan (RADV) at 4K, with Doom 3, Resurrection of Evil and The Lost Mission. Bring your own BFG Edition data.

item.title: Eternal Darkness
item.description: Eternal Darkness: Sanity's Requiem (GameCube) for PlayStation 5, recompiled to run natively at 4K and up to 120 fps with widescreen and HD texture packs. Bring your own European disc.

item.title: Ship of Harkinian (Vulkan)
item.description: Ship of Harkinian (Ocarina of Time PC port) on Vulkan: converts your own ROM on the console, 60 FPS at 4K, HD texture packs, right-stick camera and PS button prompts; tested on firmware 13.60.

item.title: Steam Remote Play
item.description: An unofficial Steam Remote Play client for PS5.

item.title: PS5CEMU-HAR
item.description: Wii U and 3DS emulation for jailbroken PS5, built on Cemu and Azahar, with one launcher for both.

item.title: NFS Most Wanted
item.description: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005), the PC version through prospero-win, installed from your own copy with widescreen, DualSense and optional Xbox 360 graphics mods.

item.title: PS5MC
item.description: PS5MC, an unofficial port of the Kodi 22 media center for PS5, with a 4K GPU interface, hardware H.264, HEVC and VP9 decoding and HDR output.

item.title: Twispero
item.description: Twitch for jailbroken PS5: live streams with chat, past broadcasts and clips on the console's own video decoder.

item.title: Jelly5
item.description: A native Jellyfin client for jailbroken PS5: its own liquid-glass interface, hardware-decoded 4K HDR

item.title: GyroAim
item.description: Gyro aiming in any game: the controller's gyroscope drives the stick, tuned from your phone while you play.

item.title: Emby5
item.description: A native Emby client for PlayStation 5 with media playback and optional Seerr requests.

item.title: Régie5
item.description: A TV remote for your self-hosted media stack: Sonarr, Radarr, Seerr and Jellyfin at a glance, with request approval, playback diagnosis and an optional cleanup.

item.title: PS5LM
item.description: Runs language and decision models on the PS5's GPU with llama.cpp and serves them to your network over OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. Decision models powered by Ollaya.

item.title: PS5LM Plus
item.description: Runs local language models (GGUF, llama.cpp) on the PS5's GPU, with a dashboard on the TV, model downloads, and a chat and OpenAI-compatible API for your network.

item.title: Cloud Play
item.description: A Chiaki-based cloud streaming client for PS5 that streams games from the PS Plus Premium catalog.

item.title: Ship of Harkinian (Ocarina of Time)
item.description: Native PS5 port of Ship of Harkinian for Ocarina of Time; requires your own game assets.

item.title: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian (Majora's Mask)
item.description: Native PS5 port of 2 Ship 2 Harkinian for Majora's Mask; requires your own game assets.

item.title: Morrowind (OpenMW)
item.description: Native PS5 port of OpenMW for Morrowind; requires your own Morrowind game data.

item.title: Twilight Princess (Dusklight)
item.description: Native PS5 port of Dusklight for Twilight Princess; requires your own USA GameCube game data.

item.title: Wind Waker HD
item.description: Native PS5 port of Wind Waker HD. Requires game files prepared from your own USA Wii U dump.

item.title: Animal Crossing for PS5
item.description: Unofficial native port of Animal Crossing for GameCube; requires your own USA revision 0 game data.

item.title: DOOM Native Port
item.description: id Software's original DOOM source running natively on the PS5, with the shareware episode. Add your own DOOM, DOOM II and Final DOOM files from a PC or phone browser, a link or FTP.

item.title: Link’s Awakening for PS5
item.description: Native PS5 port of Link’s Awakening. Requires game files prepared from your own Switch version 1.0.0 base-game dump.

item.title: OpenRCT2 Native Port
item.description: OpenRCT2, the open-source RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, running natively on the PS5 and played with the DualSense alone. Send your own game files, even the GOG installer, from a PC or phone browser.

item.title: Porpoise
item.description: A native GameCube and Wii emulator for jailbroken PS5, powered by Dolphin. Cover-flow library, box art, memory cards, original music.

item.title: PShare
item.description: Native PS5 homebrew app that sends media gallery items to Discord, Telegram, catbox.moe, a USB drive, a shared folder on your PC or a dozen other places, automatically

item.title: PICO-8 for PS5
item.description: Unofficial loader that runs your own copy of the PICO-8 Linux build as a native PS5 app.

item.title: PSBox Cloud Gaming
item.description: Unofficial Xbox Cloud Gaming client: stream the cloud catalog, your own games and your own Xbox (Remote Play) at 1080p60 with sound, using the DualSense as an Xbox controller.

item.title: Prospero Vibrate
item.description: Controller vibration studio for PS5 with live motor control, preset patterns, a custom pattern editor and timed playback.

item.title: Forwarder Manager
item.description: Create and edit home-screen forwarders that launch emulators and other apps with custom art, music and arguments.

item.title: YouTube Max’d
item.description: Standalone PS5 YouTube client based on ProsperoTube, with local voice search, Smart playlists, adaptive quality and red/white DualSense effects.

item.title: Prospero Win
item.description: Windows compatibility runtime for native PlayStation 5 homebrew.

item.title: Nuvio PS5
item.description: Nuvio TV for a jailbroken PS5, with EVO native playback and the interface served by the console itself.
